findings.one_line: The promised sound-and-complete graph-native TID-SCG dichotomy has been replaced by a sound three-way dispatcher that returns UNKNOWN throughout the unresolved cross-refinement region; position the artifact as a partial-certification result (and compare that narrower object theorem-by-theorem with the cited sufficient criteria), or supply the bounded normal form promised by the proposal.

This asserted ‘frontier’ is only the tautological absence of a third-coordinate mediator in a two-coordinate graph plus a hard-coded adjustment success; retain it as the proposal-mandated regression witness, but do not present it as an independent theorem-level advance without a nontrivial comparator or a broader frontier statement.

The HAC/delta result is a useful usable corollary conditional on SUCCESS, but the positioning does not give the required relevance/comparison treatment for its cited inference substrate (Newey--West, Viviano--Bradic, and graphical-effect inference); explicitly frame it as standard inference transport rather than a novel main contribution.
